Name: Silence is Golden
Author: sp4k0v
Description:
I love the music in Stardew Valley, but I also love the ambient sounds, especially when playing for a long time. If you set the Music Volume slider to zero in the Options menu, you may have noticed that you just get silence while the music is still playing at zero volume, then you get ambient sounds once it's done. This mod replaces configured music with a 100-millisecond silent .wav file, allowing the game to play ambient sounds almost immediately.

[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Translations]Translations[/url] are welcome!

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. (Optional, but makes configuration easier.)
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14767]Sound Tweaker[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[b][size=5]Configuration[/size][/b]
You can edit settings from the title screen ([url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/GenericModConfigMenu/docs/screenshot-title.png]via the cog button[/url]) or in-game ([url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/GenericModConfigMenu/docs/screenshot-in-game-options.png]at the bottom of the in-game Options menu[/url]).

Changes take effect when entering a new area once music has stopped playing.

[b][size=4]Options[/size][/b]
All options are true-false, representing whether or not you want music to play.

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley
[list][*]Seasonal music
[*]Secret Woods music
[*]Town music
[/list][*]Desert
[list][*]Desert music
[/list][*]Island
[list][*]Island music
[/list][*]Mines
[list][*]Mines music (also affects Skull Cavern)
[*]Volcano Dungeon music
[/list][/list]

[b][size=4]Manual configuration[/size][/b]
If you're not using Generic Mod Config Menu, create a [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file in the mod directory and tweak as desired.

Here's the default [font=Courier New]config.json[/font]:

[code]{
"SeasonalMusic": "false",
"SecretWoodsMusic": "true",
"TownMusic": "true",
"DesertMusic": "false",
"IslandMusic": "false",
"MinesMusic": "false",
"VolcanoDungeonMusic": "false"
}[/code]
